lastReleaseMessage: write-dashboard-status: preserve the full barRaise block (was stripping actions/deferred/health/lensScores on every release) and read status JSON as UTF-8

barRaise.topFinding: One commit landed since the last review (663dc73, a CLAUDE.md pointer fix) and no application code moved, so every open code finding carries forward re-verified: bulk-delete at server.ts:532-542 still deletes without a snapshot, the transactions natural key at db.ts:120 is still the four-column UNIQUE that cannot express a genuine twin charge, and the api test suite still opens the live 649-row ledger through analytics/core.ts:12. All four hard rules verify clean, so there is no BLOCK. The movement is in the audit machinery and it goes both ways: the queue prune landed and all 18 Budget rows are non-terminal, but drift-auto-fix edits from 2026-07-25 and 2026-07-26 are stacked six files deep and uncommitted, and two of them already fix findings this report still has to list as open. The 2026-07-25 synthesis also minted data-integrity-03 for a new HIGH while an open MED already held that id, shadowing it from aging, dedupe and the enqueue gate; the collision is repaired in this run's state and the mechanism is now a finding. Verdict stays needs-attention on the unguarded destructive routes and the test suite writing the live ledger.
